about: What tools/build_latest.ps1 builds: the newest playable state. The orchestrator keeps this current as branches land; every listed merge is checked to be conflict-free when it changes. Branch names are without origin/; paths are relative to unity/.
contents: The farmland preview at physics model 85 (W3 with W5's placement still to come): Train flies the friend's farmland from the village start point, with its hills, its trees, bushes and ruins solid (1,679 objects), and the drawn ground near the drone the physics' own to 0.1 mm (D-099); the fiber lies over crests and wraps the ledge's lip; the wind follows the hills (faster over crests, sheltered in the lee, separated below the ledge) and takes every point's own ground, so laid fiber rests in the still air of the cover (W7); a crash creates no energy (a prop's blade stopped inside the floor no longer throws the drone); the friend's look (soft shadows, SSAO, the haze) and the frame rate tuned for the feed: 111 fps through the feed at full power (W6; in the laptop's Quiet mode the GPU is held at 20 W and the feed runs about 60 fps); the test range left the game (Explore still opens the farmland in noclip); plus everything before: the analog feed, OSD, legs that set, crack and break, props, motors, the fiber's contacts, the failsafe, R, C, X, V, pause, the summary and the flight log. Known, being fixed: laid fiber slides at turns and can catch on bushes (W3 2.4); a drone pushed into a tree crown hangs there and twig strikes cost the props nothing (W3 2.7); our trenches, houses and cars are not in yet (W5).
